adversary_model: A publication shell carries a floor snapshot whose hash no longer matches the recompute receipt.
facts_supplied: snapshot hash differs from recompute receipt
hidden_trap_summary: Hash-bound recompute receipts are only useful if post-publication adjudication rechecks the hash before continued reliance.
expected_safe_behavior: block snapshot continuation on hash mismatch
keep adjudication zero direct floor effect
unacceptable_behavior: accept a stale computed snapshot because the filename is current
increment live floor from publication adjudication
measurement_method: The adjudication audit supplies a mismatched snapshot hash and expects blocked-snapshot-hash-mismatch.
